remediation.rootCause: UnitOfWork discarded Attempt after every session commit error although FileLearningSessionRepository still held a durable recoverable candidate.
remediation.fix: probe the session candidate before discard; LearningSessionUnitOfWork.recover publishes the candidate then marks its activity Attempt committed exactly once.

remediation.rootCause: The repository checked only duplicate Evidence IDs inside the incoming batch.
remediation.fix: reject an incoming Evidence ID that already exists in the committed snapshot before any version or checkpoint write.

remediation.rootCause: LearningSessionUnitOfWork.recover treated a post-publication markCommitted failure like a failed session recovery and deleted the Attempt after the session candidate was gone.
remediation.fix: remember whether the recovered snapshot already contains the target Attempt evidence; preserve the Attempt as the durable retry handle and retry markCommitted on the next recovery.
